component scope, commands and evidence limits

requirements.title: Bounded attitude experiment
requirements.statement: The B0 system shall execute a configured bounded multirotor attitude-estimation and control experiment without representing the experiment as full-flight capability.
requirements.rationale: Defines the single B0 product use while preventing scaffold and extension scope from becoming an implicit obligation.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Inspection confirms the joint baseline includes the bounded experiment and excludes translation, flight, hardware and unactivated extensions.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Deterministic configuration and replay
requirements.statement: The B0 system shall produce repeatable samples and state evolution for identical approved configuration, seed, initial state, input sequence, reset sequence and software revision.
requirements.rationale: Repeatability is required for engineering comparison and release evidence.

applicability.scope: all deterministic and stochastic B0 scenarios

requirements.acceptance_condition: The procedure in B0-VER-REPLAY compares two approved replays at the G0 reset-replay fields and tolerances and records configuration, seed and revision.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Runtime truth isolation
requirements.statement: The B0 system shall prevent live plant truth from entering estimator or controller runtime inputs after explicit initialization while permitting truth to reach sensor generation and independent evaluation.
requirements.rationale: Prevents circular validation and unrealistically privileged control or estimation.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Static interface inspection and a later integrated negative test show no runtime truth path to estimator or controller, using the G0 truth_visibility and truth_inputs_forbidden fields.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Shared frames units and quaternion convention
requirements.statement: The B0 system shall represent exchanged quantities using the approved NED and body frames, SI units, and scalar-first Hamilton quaternion convention.
requirements.rationale: A single convention prevents silent sign, frame and ordering defects across components.

applicability.scope: all B0 component interfaces and retained evidence

requirements.acceptance_condition: Inspection and component analytical cases confirm every interface and oracle references the approved G0 convention fields without a conflicting local definition.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Rigid-body rotational dynamics
requirements.statement: The B0 plant shall propagate body angular velocity using the approved rigid-body rotational equation and positive-definite inertia contract.
requirements.rationale: Defines the physical responsibility required by the bounded attitude experiment.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Analytical zero-torque and principal-axis cases match an independent equation oracle at the G0 precision and inertia references.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Quaternion plant state
requirements.statement: The B0 plant shall propagate and normalize its scalar-first attitude quaternion using the approved body-rate and frame convention.
requirements.rationale: Attitude propagation must remain consistent with the shared representation.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Independent constant-rate analytical cases account for q/-q equivalence and confirm normalization within the approved G0 tolerance.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Paired torque command
requirements.statement: The B0 controller shall publish one timestamped torque command that pairs requested torque, limited target and saturation status from the same controller due tick.
requirements.rationale: The pairing closes ambiguity between request, clamp result and anti-windup feedback.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Interface inspection and a later timing test confirm the three fields and timestamp correspond to one due tick as defined by the G0 torque-command and request-limit-pairing fields.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Limited-target actuator dynamics
requirements.statement: The B0 actuator shall advance its response using only the held limited target from the latest eligible paired torque command.
requirements.rationale: Prevents a raw request from bypassing the controller's unique saturation responsibility.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Component tests compare the response with an independent first-order and clamp oracle and reject a raw-request dynamics path using the G0 dynamics_input field.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Actuator feedback pairing
requirements.statement: The B0 actuator shall publish actual torque and the originating paired-command timestamp in actuator feedback.
requirements.rationale: Controller anti-windup must associate actual response with the correct limited target.
requirements.acceptance_condition: A multi-rate interface test confirms feedback preserves the eligible command timestamp and corresponding limited target according to the G0 held-command contract.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Gyroscope measurement
requirements.statement: The B0 IMU shall produce timestamped body-frame angular-rate measurements with the approved bias, noise, validity and seed semantics.
requirements.rationale: Defines the estimator's angular-rate observation boundary.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Stationary, constant-rate, bias and deterministic-noise component cases match independent signal and random-sequence oracles.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Accelerometer specific force
requirements.statement: The B0 IMU shall produce timestamped body-frame specific-force measurements using the approved gravity sign, bias, noise, validity and seed semantics.
requirements.rationale: Specific force rather than inertial acceleration is the estimator input.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Aligned and rotated stationary cases, bias and deterministic-noise cases match the independent G0 specific-force equation and sign oracle.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Estimator propagation
requirements.statement: The B0 estimator shall propagate and normalize a scalar-first attitude estimate from valid gyroscope samples and approved positive time increments.
requirements.rationale: Defines the minimum planned G2 attitude propagation responsibility.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Planned component tests compare constant-rate propagation with an independent quaternion oracle and verify normalization and invalid-dt rejection.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Roll and pitch fusion
requirements.statement: The B0 estimator shall apply bounded accelerometer-based roll and pitch correction only when the approved validity and bounded-specific-force conditions permit it.
requirements.rationale: Gravity-based tilt correction is conditional and must not silently treat all acceleration as gravity.

applicability.scope: planned G2 estimator when the approved correction gate is valid

requirements.acceptance_condition: Planned stationary-tilt and gated-contamination tests compare with an independent tilt oracle and the G0 estimator correction conditions.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Yaw observability limitation
requirements.statement: The B0 system shall report yaw as relative propagation and drift without claiming absolute yaw observability from gyroscope and accelerometer measurements alone.
requirements.rationale: Gravity provides no absolute heading reference.

applicability.scope: six-axis IMU-only B0 estimator and reports

requirements.acceptance_condition: Inspection and the noise/bias scenario report separate roll/pitch correction from relative yaw drift and contain no absolute-yaw recovery claim.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Acceleration contamination handling
requirements.statement: The B0 estimator shall expose the approved limitation or correction-gating status when non-gravitational specific force violates its bounded tilt-correction assumptions.
requirements.rationale: The bounded attitude model lacks complete translational dynamics and must characterize rather than hide this limitation.

applicability.scope: acceleration-contamination scenario and any sample outside correction assumptions

requirements.acceptance_condition: The planned contamination provision observes required raw signals and limitation status and classifies the case as limitation characterization rather than performance pass.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Cascaded attitude and rate control
requirements.statement: The B0 controller shall compute body-torque request through the approved attitude-error and body-rate feedback signs in a cascaded attitude and rate structure.
requirements.rationale: Defines the planned G2 controller responsibility without importing legacy geometric or LQR scaffolds.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Planned unit tests use independent sign and axis oracles for positive/negative attitude and rate errors and reject the opposite-feedback mutation.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Unique controller saturation responsibility
requirements.statement: The B0 controller shall be the sole component that limits requested body torque to the approved target bounds and sets the paired saturation status.
requirements.rationale: A single clamp authority prevents inconsistent targets and ambiguous feedback.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Boundary tests exercise every axis and confirm request, limited target and saturation status against the G0 controller limits while no downstream component reclamps the target.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Anti-windup update
requirements.statement: The B0 controller shall update each rate-integral contribution using the approved conditional-integration and paired-feedback back-calculation rule and shall enforce the approved per-axis integral bounds.
requirements.rationale: The complete discrete rule must respond to both clamp saturation and actuator lag without silently accumulating beyond bounds.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Planned discrete-step tests independently calculate conditional integration, back-calculation and each axis bound from the approved G0 anti-windup fields.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Invalid input rejection
requirements.statement: The B0 system shall reject invalid, non-finite, stale, mis-shaped or non-positive-time inputs according to the owning component contract without silently advancing state.
requirements.rationale: Explicit rejection preserves state ownership and makes invalid trials auditable.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Negative-dt, stale-timestamp and representative invalid-value tests observe the approved rejection reason and unchanged owned state.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Reset contract
requirements.statement: The B0 system shall reset all stateful components to explicit initial state, seed and epoch-local scheduling while preserving the monotonically increasing scenario clock and discarding pre-reset held commands and feedback.
requirements.rationale: A single reset boundary is necessary for deterministic replay without stale state leakage.
requirements.acceptance_condition: The reset provision verifies the G0 reset tick, epoch-local first due updates, scenario timestamps, cleared held data and deterministic comparison window.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Deterministic scheduling and timestamps
requirements.statement: The B0 execution adapter shall schedule component updates and construct timestamps from integer base ticks using the approved due-phase, consumption and held-command rules.
requirements.rationale: The execution adapter owns ordering and prevents timing drift or ambiguous sample consumption.
requirements.acceptance_condition: A trace inspection and later multi-rate test match every produced/consumed sample and command to the G0 sequence, period, first-due-tick and timestamp rules.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Approved scenario suite
requirements.statement: The B0 system shall support the approved normal, initial-offset, signed-step, disturbance, noise-and-bias, saturation-withdrawal, acceleration-contamination, and invalid-input-and-reset scenarios.
requirements.rationale: These scenarios bound the required engineering questions without extending to flight.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Inspection confirms each approved G0 v2 scenario ID has a verification purpose, required observations, applicable criteria, responsibility and invalid-result handling.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Independent evaluation
requirements.statement: The B0 evaluator shall compute acceptance metrics independently of estimator and controller implementations using the approved raw signals, windows, units, aggregation and invalid-data rules.
requirements.rationale: Independent oracles prevent the tested algorithm from grading itself.

applicability.scope: B0 component and integrated performance evaluation

requirements.acceptance_condition: Design inspection identifies a distinct oracle and all required raw-signal dependencies for each verification provision; later executions use the G0 metric definitions and result classes.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Evidence provenance
requirements.statement: The B0 release evidence shall identify software revision, approved configuration hash, scenario, seed, environment, command, raw artifact, metric implementation and terminal result classification.
requirements.rationale: A pass/fail statement without provenance is not reproducible evidence.

applicability.scope: future G3/G4 executions and release evidence

requirements.acceptance_condition: The planned evidence manifest schema and release demonstration require every listed provenance field and reject missing or mismatched versions; execution remains assigned to later stages.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Defect-detection demonstration
requirements.statement: The B0 release process shall demonstrate that selected independent checks detect isolated sign, unit, quaternion-ordering or anti-windup defects without modifying the approved production baseline.
requirements.rationale: A limited mutation demonstration provides evidence that critical checks are capable of failing.
requirements.acceptance_condition: The G4 provision defines isolated variants, expected failing checks, restoration controls and retained outcomes; this baseline contains no fabricated mutation result.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Implementation language boundary
requirements.statement: The B0 implementation shall provide the control core in C++17 and may use Python for simulation, orchestration and independent analysis through the approved interface boundary.
requirements.rationale: Preserves the intended portable control core while retaining productive analysis tooling.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Build and interface inspection confirm the control-core target uses C++17 and Python-facing integration does not bypass the declared messages or truth boundary.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Clean-checkout reproduction
requirements.statement: The B0 release shall be reproducible from a clean checkout using documented dependency versions and commands without relying on untracked developer state.
requirements.rationale: A local green workspace is insufficient release evidence.
requirements.acceptance_condition: The G4 reproduction provision starts from a clean revision, installs pinned dependencies, runs documented commands and verifies retained artifact hashes; execution is not claimed in G1.5-B.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Legacy control disposition
requirements.statement: The B0 system shall retain CTL-REQ-001 and CTL-REQ-002 unchanged as historical references and shall record their approved not-applicable disposition for current B0 without a satisfaction claim.
requirements.rationale: Preserves historical identifiers while preventing incompatible legacy thresholds from silently becoming B0 criteria.

applicability.scope: CTL-REQ-001 and CTL-REQ-002 for current B0 only

requirements.acceptance_condition: Inspection confirms both historical records and thresholds are unchanged, the approval locator resolves, current B0 says not applicable, and no satisfied/pass state is attached.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: Invalid measurement handling
requirements.statement: The B0 estimator and controller shall not consume an invalid or stale measurement as a valid update and shall expose the approved rejection or hold status.
requirements.rationale: Validity must affect consumption rather than serving as passive metadata.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Planned component and integration tests inject invalid and stale samples and confirm no valid update occurs, state ownership is preserved and the required status is observable.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.

requirements.title: B0 exclusion boundary
requirements.statement: The B0 system shall exclude position and velocity loops, waypoint flight, full INS or GNSS estimation, advanced-control comparisons, learning algorithms, embedded targets, HIL and flight claims unless a separately approved extension activates them.
requirements.rationale: Makes the stopping rule reviewable and prevents legacy scaffolds from expanding B0.
requirements.acceptance_condition: Inspection of requirements, model, verification specifications and reports finds no activated excluded capability or unsupported flight, HIL, hardware or research claim.
requirements.change_note: Initial D1-authorized allocation; candidate until D2.
